s01E43E.name: Dry Bones/Bony Beetle: collapse, walk, hurt
summary: Second half of the Dry Bones / Bony Beetle main routine (sprites $30, $31, $32). [$1534] = collapsed flag.
Collapsed: draws a bone pile of two tiles, shakes during the last $40 frames, then stands up when [$1540] runs out.
Walking: speed from DATA_01E41F, slope adjusted; $31 (Bony Beetle) cycles a spike phase using [$1540]; $30 and $32 (in translevel $31) throw bones.
CODE_01E5C4: stomping collapses the sprite ([$1534]++, [$1540] = $FF) unless the beetle has spikes out, which hurts Mario.

s01E611.name: Table: springboard animation frames
summary: Frame number written to [$1602] indexed by [$1540]/2.

s01E61A.name: Table: springboard Mario Y offsets
summary: Mario's Y offset from the sprite indexed by [$1540]/2; +$12 added on Yoshi.

SpringBoard.name: Portable springboard main routine
summary: Sprite $2F. Physics (gravity, friction, wall bounce) like other carryable sprites.
[$1540] is the bounce timer (starts at $11 when Mario lands): Mario is held on top, then launched with Y speed $B0 or, with A/B held, $80 (spin jump if A).
Not bouncing: Mario can stand on it, or pick it up with X/Y (status $0B). Always ends by drawing two tiles via SubSprGfx0Entry1. $01E6F0 is also the entry used while stunned/carried.

SmushedGfxRt.name: Draw smushed sprite
summary: Draws a flattened sprite as two 8x8 tiles side by side (second flipped horizontally), 8 pixels lower than the sprite position.
Tile depends on sprite number: $3E POW = $FE, $BD or <4 = $EE, 4-$0E (Koopas) = $4D, others $C7. Called from the stunned/killed-state graphics.

PSwitch.name: Sprite $19/$3E main stub (message trigger)
summary: Shared by sprites $19 (message box) and $3E (POW). When [$1564] reaches 1: sets [$1F11] and [$1FB8] to 1, erases the sprite and increments [$1426] (message box trigger).
Purpose of the two flags is unclear; the POW itself is mostly handled elsewhere.

s01E76F.name: Table: cloud puff X offsets
summary: 16 values: 4 animation frames x 4 puffs.

s01E77F.name: Table: cloud puff Y offsets
summary: 16 values used (4 frames x 4 puffs), 4 trailing bytes not referenced in this chunk.

s01E793.name: Table: cloud wobble offsets
summary: Y offsets of the cloud below Mario or of Lakitu above the cloud, indexed by 0-7 (+8 on Yoshi).

LakituCloud.name: Lakitu's cloud main routine
summary: Sprite $87. If sprites are locked just draws it, otherwise falls into NoCloudGfx.

NoCloudGfx.name: Lakitu's cloud logic
summary: Counts down the cloud life [$18E0] every 4th frame; when it ends [$1540] = $1F and the cloud vanishes, then Lakitu is respawned ([RAM_SpriteToRespawn] = $1E, timer $FF).
Looks for a Lakitu in slots 0-9: if found, the cloud follows him ([$160E] = slot, CODE_01E898).
Otherwise state 0 = empty cloud (falls, Mario can land on it), state 1 = Mario riding it (position follows Mario, B jumps off).

LakituCloudGfx.name: Draw Lakitu's cloud
summary: Draws four 16x16 puffs from DATA_01E76F/DATA_01E77F with an animation that depends on the frame counter, plus an 8x8 face tile at OAM slot 2 ($0208).
Puff tile shrinks via CloudTiles while [$1540] counts down. OAM indexes $F8/$FC and $00 or $30 (empty cloud).

CloudTiles.name: Cloud tiles, speed limits, cloud movement
summary: CloudTiles: tiles $66,$64,$62,$60. DATA_01E989/01E98B: max X speed and Y bob limit.
$01E98D: cloud movement. Faces Lakitu toward Mario (or away if [$18BF] is set), accelerates X every other frame toward +/-$20, bobs in Y between +/-$10, adds scroll speed [$17BD]*8.
Every 128 frames it makes the Lakitu throw (sets his [$1558] = $20, calls CODE_01EA21 to spawn).
